description:
The feature is genuinely unbuilt. `grep -rn
"GRADUATED_TO_ANY\|DEFAULTED_TO_ANY\|graduated" src/diag/codes.rs
src/compiler2/` returns 0 hits, so neither `TYPE_PARAM_GRADUATED_TO_ANY` nor
`TYPE_STRUCT_FIELD_DEFAULTED_TO_ANY` exists.

The machinery is ready and unchanged: `World::emit_warning_once` (world.rs:2808),
`WarningDiagnosticKey` dedup (world.rs:90), two live callers
(jobs/source.rs:268, jobs/contract.rs:113).

## THE BLAST-RADIUS MEASUREMENT IS STALE -- re-take it before planning

The 2026-06-25 comment clustered ~101 newly-failing tests into three roots and
concluded "the ~101 is dominated by ONE root (f98.10 protocol erasure)", then
recommended "BURN DOWN THE ROOT FIRST ... then land f98.9 fatal with only the
small residual disabled".

Both of the roots it named are now CLOSED: fz-f98.10 and fz-f98.12. Only the
third (fz-f98.11, now fz-kdt.14, itself described as downstream) remains open --
and it has been re-scoped: the operator cluster it was filed against is clean
everywhere observable, and what survives is Map's Enumerable element erasing to a
tuple of `any`.

So the sequencing constraint's precondition HAS BEEN MET, and the "lib 89 failed
/ matrix 57" numbers must be re-measured before anyone plans around them.

## The motivating example is also fixed

The comment says this warning "would have caught" Range's fields being `any`.
`src/modules/runtime_library/range.fz:6` now declares
`@type t :: %Range{first: integer, last: integer, step: integer}`, so that bug no
longer exists to catch. Find a current motivating example before building the
detector, or the warning ships with no demonstrated value.

## Could not measure

The current graduated-`any` population. Doing so requires implementing the
detection this ticket is about; there is no existing telemetry event that
surfaces a param position widening to `any`.

## Recommended first step

Re-run the detection prototype and re-take the blast radius against the current
tree. Only then decide non-fatal-lint-first versus gate-behind-the-roots -- the
old decision was made against a world where 100 tests failed and two of the three
roots were open.
title: Warn when a parameter or struct field type is graduated or defaulted to any
